name: Seachem Equilibrium
description: GH / mineral builder for soft or RO water — adds K, Ca, and Mg without sodium or chloride. Manufacturer-disclosed: 16 g in 80 L raises GH by 3 dGH (1 meq/L). Guaranteed analysis: 23% K2O, 8.06% Ca, 2.41% Mg.
notes: Raises GH only (not KH). The Ca:Mg ratio (~3.3:1) suits most planted tanks. Contributes potassium, so factor it into a K-dosing plan.
